title: Lawnchair Aces
description: Lawn chairs hang from clusters of helium balloons over a forest lake, and everyone brought a pellet rifle. Pop the other chairs' balloons until they splash down. Climb or sink to catch a different wind, and give the leaf blower a burst when you need a nudge.
controls: Click the view to aim. Click fires; hold R to pump and reload; right mouse scopes in; Space pours water to climb; hold E to let a balloon go; W runs the leaf blower; Shift steadies; V changes view; Esc pauses. Touch controls are in the settings.
